name: tetrilaunch
description: Tetrilaunch — a neon-arcade physics cannon puzzle. Capacitor port (web / Android / iOS).

scripts.build:native: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode native
scripts.cap:add:android: cap add android && npm run patch:android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && npm run verify:store && cap sync android && npm run patch:android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && npm run verify:store && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.assets:generate: node scripts/rasterize-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --assetPath resources && node scripts/stage-android-assets.mjs
scripts.build:teststore: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode teststore
scripts.android:sync:test: npm run build:teststore && node scripts/verify-store-bundle.mjs --allow-test-key && cap sync android && npm run patch:android
scripts.android:apk:test: npm run android:sync:test && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
